scope: 核验题名、作者、年份与来源；摘要级方法调研，不声称全部全文精读。比较方法不等于已部署实现。

papers.title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors
papers.role: MLP梯度传播的方法来源；本例权重由TensorFlow.js实际训练

papers.title: Deep learning
papers.role: 多层表示与卷积网络的背景综述；不直接提供石油模型权重

papers.title: Gradient-based learning applied to document recognition
papers.role: 卷积与降采样思想；本站使用1D窗口并非复现文档识别基准

papers.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
papers.role: 实际采用的Adam优化器；一阶矩与二阶矩的自适应更新

papers.title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
papers.role: 正则化比较阅读；当前默认模型没有Dropout，不伪称已启用

papers.title: Visualizing the Loss Landscape of Neural Nets
papers.role: 损失切片的可视化动机；本站计算末层权重与偏置的精确二维切片，不冒称滤波器归一化全参数景观

papers.title: TensorFlow.js: Machine Learning for the Web and Beyond
papers.role: 浏览器训练和张量计算的运行基础

papers.title: CNN Explainer: Learning Convolutional Neural Networks with Interactive Visualization
papers.role: 分层概览与局部数学细节的交互设计参考；不直接复制其图像分类模型

papers.title: D³ Data-Driven Documents
papers.role: 数据驱动网络、树和图谱的实际绘制基础

papers.title: All Models are Wrong, but Many are Useful: Learning a Variable's Importance by Studying an Entire Class of Prediction Models Simultaneously
papers.role: 置换重要性的解释边界；本站只计算单模型的置换误差差，不计算MCR区间

papers.title: Why Should I Trust You?: Explaining the Predictions of Any Classifier
papers.role: 局部解释的比较文献；本站不把响应面或置换重要性命名为LIME

papers.title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
papers.role: 加性归因的比较阅读；本站未实现SHAP，置换误差增量不冒充Shapley值

papers.title: Random Forests
papers.role: 实际随机森林的集成思想；mljs实现训练与预测

papers.title: Bagging predictors
papers.role: 自助采样与集成的来源；森林成员并非神经元

papers.title: Induction of decision trees
papers.role: 树划分思想的比较背景；本例实际为回归树并非ID3分类器

papers.title: Bootstrap Methods: Another Look at the Jackknife
papers.role: 重采样方法背景；不把树间波动直接当作校准置信区间

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Log Interpretation - A Review
papers.role: 测井任务、数据质量与泛化边界的领域综述，不提供本站合成数据

papers.title: Using Artificial Neural Networks to Predict the Quality and Performance of Oilfield Cements
papers.role: 水泥材料表征与神经网络预测的领域先例；本站未取得其原始光谱数据

papers.title: Machine Learning-Based Completions Sequencing for Well Performance Optimization
papers.role: 完井多因素预测的领域背景，强调模型局限；不直接验证本站工具或控流案例

papers.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling
papers.role: 原射孔TCN案例的因果膨胀卷积参考；新1D-CNN不冒称TCN

papers.title: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
papers.role: 原射孔XGBoost模型的树集成依据；新森林不冒称XGBoost

papers.title: Soft-DTW: a Differentiable Loss Function for Time-Series
papers.role: 原射孔DTW配准的比较方法；不声称硬DTW实现了soft-DTW梯度

papers.title: Gaussian Processes for Machine Learning
papers.role: GPR后验、核矩阵与条件方差的专门来源；当前固定RBF核，不冒称复现书中全部方法

papers.title: Gaussian Processes for Regression
papers.role: 高斯过程回归的方法来源；本例用ml-matrix执行Cholesky求解

papers.title: Practical Bayesian Optimization of Machine Learning Algorithms
papers.role: 原射孔贝叶斯优化的研究参考；新GPR没有声称自动优化超参数

papers.title: Long Short-Term Memory
papers.role: LSTM门控记忆的方法依据；实际门值从当前模型权重计算

papers.title: LSTMVis: A Tool for Visual Analysis of Hidden State Dynamics in Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.role: 时序隐状态热图的可视化研究来源；不加载原文语言模型

papers.title: Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks
papers.role: 压缩瓶颈与重构训练的研究基础；本例不是变分自编码器

papers.title: Physics-informed neural networks: A deep learning framework for solving forward and inverse problems involving nonlinear partial differential equations
papers.role: 物理残差训练的来源；本站新例仅代数达西型约束，不复现PDE基准
